decision.observation: Excellent reveal: a tiered dark-rock cliff rises ahead-left with palm trees and pale stone blocks/ruin slabs (tombstone-like) set on its ledges, plus a faint blue glow at the top-left. Red sand ramps wind up from the foreground between the palms. Purple dusk sky, open sand at center-right.
decision.hypothesis: This is the ruin ascent — the red sand ramps are the walkable route past the palms toward the stone slabs on the ledges. Walking forward up the sand ramp is the way up without needing a grip.
decision.memory: Key landmark: tiered dark cliff with palms and pale ruin slabs on ledges, blue glow above-left, red sand ramps at its base. This is a route, not a wall.
